t: Listen to a talk in an environmental science class.
Today's topic is how city noise changes bird communication.
Traffic noise is mostly low-pitched, so many city birds now sing at a higher pitch than birds of the same species in forests.
Some also sing earlier in the morning, before rush hour starts.
These changes help their songs be heard.
Researchers have also noticed that city birds are often less afraid of people, though that is probably a separate effect.
